meta.title: Why I'm Buying This AI Selloff, Best Stocks to Buy Now!
meta.thread_line: 4 threads · why AI stocks are selling off · Lam Research and the 50% retracement · Broadcom bought live · Applied Optoelectronics as a spec buy

snapshot: AI selloff day: Nasdaq -1.81%, AMD -5.96%, Lam Research -10% at the open despite beating, Nvidia -2.71%, Broadcom -2.5%.
Causes named: a monster run, macro noise (Brent at **$112**, sticky CPI/PPI, Fed hike fears), algos selling the whole basket.
Earnings say the cycle isn't over: Supermicro raised guidance to **$18.5-19.5B**, SpaceX revenue up 161%, TSMC profit up 68.7%.
His rule: after a parabolic run, DCA around the **50% retracement**, which he says works 90% of the time.
Buys: Lam Research DCA zone $200-250 (he already holds it), Broadcom bought live at $324.97, Applied Optoelectronics added at $69.97 as a spec.
Bold call: a Santa Claus rally after the midterms unless a negative catalyst hits; Fear & Greed at 20.

themes.title: Fundamentals vs sentiment: the AI buildout is accelerating while stocks fall
themes.lead: He reads the drop as profit-taking and macro fear, not a broken cycle; earnings keep beating.
bullets: Brent at $112 keeps inflation sticky and raises Fed-hike risk; consumer spending is 68% of GDP.
Supermicro raised guidance from $14.5-15.5B to $18.5-19.5B on AI platform demand, though he dislikes its low margins.
SpaceX revenue $14.58B, up 161%; the neocloud business drove the $7.56B super-intelligence segment; S-1 says 93% of TAM is xAI Grok.
SpaceX neocloud deals: Anthropic (220,000 Nvidia GPUs, multi-year) and Google ($920M for 110,000 GPUs), with some use-it-or-lose-it risk.
TSMC net profit up 68.7%, 2026 capex raised to $60-64B; demand broadening beyond GPUs as data centres shift to inference.
Institutions lock in calendar-year gains into the holidays; FOMO on the way up, "FOOL" (fear of losing everything) on the way down.

quote.text: Even stuff that shouldn't sell off is going to get sold off with the basket.

themes.watch: He runs a paid Discord and a community portfolio that holds the stocks he recommends.

themes.title: Lam Research beat and fell 10%; he'd DCA near the 50% retracement
themes.lead: Street whisper numbers were too high and guidance sandbagged; he's held for 10+ years under $15 cost basis.
bullets: Beat top and bottom lines; flagged a $200B+ opportunity and a segment worth $2.5B by decade end.
Guide short of the whisper because China revenue drops and supply-chain limits; he expects them to beat their own guide (as in 2022).
50% gross margins, $311,000 net income per employee, 31% forward revenue growth, ~28 GAAP forward P/E vs sector 29.58, 0.5% yield growing 16%.
Up 325% in five years, 67% in one year; ran from $55.81 (April 2025) to $438.02.
50% retracement = $246.92; DCA $200-250 using good-till-cancel limit orders in several lots.
SPRX's Ivana was bullish on Lam in his earlier podcast.

quote.text: This works 90% of the time if you look at charts.

themes.watch: The 90% retracement hit rate is his own claim from his chart sessions.

themes.title: Broadcom bought on camera at $324.97
themes.lead: Same retracement logic: from $39 to $493, the zone near $325 is his buy area with a floor around $300.
bullets: 75% gross margin, 50% growth, ~36.5 forward P/E.
Held since 2018 in his main portfolio; community portfolio cost basis $340, 1.8% of the account; three shares filled at $324.97 while recording.
Mix now about 70% semis / 30% infrastructure software (CA, VMware, Carbon Black).
VMware customers are "deeply unhappy" after aggressive post-acquisition changes, weighing on sentiment.

themes.title: Applied Optoelectronics: a cash-burning spec he's buying in lots
themes.lead: 120% growth but 28.92% gross margin and no GAAP profit; the bet rests on its Sugar Land, Texas plant.
bullets: Non-GAAP forward P/E 113, forward price-to-sales 6.75: expensive.
Target a 50% position around $75, saving room; downside could reach $47.
Buy in ~20 lots, never all at once; added 15 shares at $69.97.
Not the stock to own with high rates and cash burn; for risk-averse investors, avoid.

takeaways.title: Set limit orders around the 50% retracement of a parabolic run instead of chasing
Buy in lots and pre-set a target position size before averaging down
Compare guidance to whisper numbers, not just consensus
Buy in extreme fear and trim when RSIs hit 70-90

hot_takes.take: This works 90% of the time if you look at charts.
Once midterms done, I think there's a chance you see a Santa Claus rally, a year-end rally
SpaceX is really an AI company.

claims.claim: A Santa Claus rally is likely after the midterms unless a negative catalyst emerges.
Lam Research will beat its own conservative guidance.
2027 could be a decent year for stocks.

glossary.def: Midpoint of a run's low and high, used as a buy zone after a parabolic move.
Unofficial Street expectation that can exceed published consensus.
His term: fear of losing everything, the downside twin of FOMO.
Good-till-cancel limit order that stays open until filled.
